reviews.title: Total Rip-off – Don’t Pay for Features You Already Own!
reviews.text:
Do not waste your money on this app. It is essentially a "scam" in the sense that they are charging a high subscription fee for features that are built into your iPhone and Apple Watch for completely free.
This app markets itself as a necessary tool for focus and mindfulness, but it’s just a middleman.
• The "Limit" Feature: Your iPhone already has "Screen Time" and "App Limits" built into the Settings menu. You can block any app or category for free without a subscription.
• The Meditation Timer: The Apple Watch literally comes with a "Mindfulness" app (the blue flower icon) and a "Mind & Body" workout mode. Both do exactly what this app does—track your time and add it to your rings—without a monthly fee.
• The "Calming Sounds": You can find "Background Sounds" in your Apple Watch/iPhone Accessibility settings or just use a free playlist on YouTube/Spotify.
They lure you in with a "free trial" and then hit you with a massive charge, banking on the fact that you won’t realize your phone already does all of this. It's predatory, especially since it targets people looking for mental clarity. Save your money and just use the Apple Health and Screen Time tools already on your device.

reviews.title: Money always wins
reviews.text: I downloaded the app when it first appeared and bought a number of meditations. With the constant renewal and upselling of the app ( and the intrusive questioning) my meditations have disappeared. When you buy a book it is yours forever. When you buy something on the internet- not so much.

reviews.title: App staat permanent vast op “wachten tot sync voltooid is” op apple watch series 11
reviews.text: Deze app voor het eerst geinstalleerd op mijn nieuwe iphone 17 pro én nieuwe apple watch series 11. Beiden voorzien van nieuwste software en updates. Op mijn telefoon werkt hij prima maar op de watch blijft hij eeuwig hangen op “wachten tot de synchronisatie is voltooid”. Niets helpt: beiden toestellen rebooten, bluetooth en/of wifi  aan en uit zetten, app van watch verwijderen en opniew installeren: het is dramatisch. Om te janken.

reviews.title: Useful meditation timer
reviews.text:
I primarily use this app to as a timer for silent meditation. Sometimes I wish there was a 20 minute option along with the 5, 15, and 30. I like the background noise choices and usually use the beach wave sounds, which reminds me of my retreat center. Have not used the spoken voice guided meditation so cannot comment on that. Have been using the timer daily for a long time and am happy.

UPDATE: Unfortunately, the meditations are now mostly in app purchase content of guided meditations by popular pseudo-Buddhist teachers. I can access timed silent meditations used in the past by me under “profile” but now you have to tap a couple times and make sure it is playing, so you are not meditating while believing the timer is running but it is not. It appears to be no longer possible to set a new silent meditation. I can only replay what is in my history under profile. So if you only want guided meditations, there are a few free ones in the long list, but if you want a timed, silent meditation with bells, it no longer exists apparently.

reviews.title: Amazing app but zero customer service - edited
reviews.text: Edited my review. Something happened and suddenly I wasn’t a subscriber any more. I know it hadn’t lapsed as my payment wasn’t due for at least four months. It wouldn’t let me restore purchases so I emailed support twice and got no response. I’d snagged an amazing yearly deal for the whole suite of apps, now my only option is to pay almost three times that for just this one! No thank you. Highly disappointed as I’d been using apps by this developer for years.

reviews.title: Thievery
reviews.text:
I once was a big fan of this app — in fact, all the apps from this developer. Then they got greedy. 

Their Growth Bundle provided reasonable pricing for all of their apps and I've been a subscriber for five years. But my recently-renewed subscription is no longer active in any but one of the 10 apps I use — and I'm being gouged to the tune of $340+ every year if I want to continue using them.

Developer support is nonexistent; my email messages are being ignored. Given the plethora of reasonably-priced apps that do what this app does, you're better off looking someplace else.

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: I enjoyed this app for years when it was free. Two weeks ago I wanted to revisit my favorite body scan meditation and paid for an annual subscription. Now I can’t access anything on this app. It stops me and asks for more money. Amazing!
